archetypes.name: shipstate
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes python/ship.py terminal state, merge preservation, finalize writes, and retry/stall behavior in a high-risk state machine.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the Python ship driver state transitions, especially ship-pr-state.sh merging, finalize-state.sh writes, terminal outcome overlays, transient retry handling, and postmerge stall paths. Check that invalid tmpdirs and immediate re-entry outcomes avoid disk writes while terminal outcomes persist enough metadata for teardown and recovery. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: selector
archetypes.rationale: The default Step 8+ driver flip depends on prompt prose, shell contracts, docs, and tests staying mutually consistent.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the integration boundary between skills/implement/SKILL.md, stall recovery, conflict resolution, docs, and tests for the Python-default versus bash-opt-in selector. Look for any remaining paths that parse bash ship-pr-state continuation, invoke the fenced bash contract, or pass bash-only resume flags on the Python default path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds and modifies many bash helpers where portability, quoting, symlink checks, and quiet stdout contracts are easy to regress.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect changed shell scripts for Bash 3.2 compatibility, strict-mode safety, quoting, array usage, path canonicalization, symlink handling, stdout versus stderr discipline, and helper fallback behavior. Pay special attention to scripts added around scope-reduction markers, plan review scope anchors, voter prompts, and stall recovery classification. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate whether the new scope-reduction marker and scope-anchor flow preserves the intended plan-review voting semantics end to end. Trace marker detection, ballot rendering, voter prompt construction, tally acceptance, revision behavior, and related harness coverage for drift or inconsistent interpretations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: promptsafe
archetypes.rationale: The diff inlines untrusted plan or issue scope content into prompts and relies on redaction and tag escaping to prevent prompt injection or leakage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the handling of untrusted scope-anchor and ballot evidence in prompt-rendering paths for prompt injection resistance, tag escaping, redaction, size limits, and allowed-path validation. Check whether generated prompts clearly separate evidence from instructions without creating malformed tags or accidentally exposing secrets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
